description: Final polish: add build/deploy documentation in website/README.md, ensure the monorepo root acknowledges the website, and verify the complete build produces a deployable static site.
steps: Create website/README.md with: project overview, development commands (npm run dev, npm run build, npm run preview), deployment instructions for both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages (without actually deploying), directory structure explanation, how to add/edit content
Add a brief note in the root README.md (both EN and TR) mentioning the /website directory as the project's documentation site
Ensure .gitignore in /website properly excludes node_modules/, dist/, and .astro/
Verify the final build produces a clean dist/ that can be deployed as-is to any static host
acceptance_criteria: website/README.md exists with clear development and deployment instructions
Running `cd website && npm run build` still succeeds after all changes
The dist/ output is self-contained (no broken asset references)
verification: Verify dist/ contains index.html and all static assets
